newsitem.title: USA: Steel Technologies to buy Atlantic Coil.
newsitem.headline: Steel Technologies to buy Atlantic Coil.

text.p: Steel Technologies Inc said Monday it has reached an agreement to buy Atlantic Coil Processing Inc for $20 million.
The acquisition of the North Carolina-based company is expected to be completed April 1, Steel Technologies said.
It will add three processing facilities to the eight operations it currently runs in the United States and Mexico, it said.

"This acquisition, along with our facility expansions and the added availability of raw material later this year, will positively impact our earnings in 1998 and beyond," said Merwin Ray, chairman of the company.
